note: Mandatory-control catalogue. A control is covered when a requirement both cites one of its regulations and shows its keywords; partially covered when only one of the two holds.

controls.title: Customer identification and verification
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall collect and verify each customer's identity against approved identity documents before an account is activated.

controls.title: Risk-based customer categorisation
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall assign every customer a documented low, medium or high risk category at onboarding and re-assess it when customer information or behaviour changes.

controls.title: Sanctions and watchlist screening
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall screen customers and related parties against applicable sanctions lists at onboarding and whenever the lists are updated, and hold the account until potential matches are resolved.

controls.title: PEP identification and senior approval
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall identify politically exposed persons during onboarding and require senior management approval before activating their accounts.

controls.title: Beneficial ownership of legal entities
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall identify and verify the beneficial owners of every legal-entity customer and record the ownership structure.

controls.title: Enhanced due diligence for high-risk customers
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall trigger enhanced due diligence, including additional evidence and compliance approval, for customers categorised as high risk.

controls.title: Notice and consent for personal data
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall present a clear privacy notice and capture the customer's recorded consent, with timestamp and purpose, before collecting identity data or biometrics.

controls.title: Data minimisation and purpose limitation
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall collect only the identity data necessary for KYC and shall not reuse it for other purposes without separate consent.

controls.title: Record retention for at least five years
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall retain KYC identification and transaction records for at least five years after the relationship ends and delete them securely afterwards.

controls.title: Periodic KYC refresh (re-KYC)
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall schedule periodic KYC updates by customer risk category and notify customers before their KYC expires.

controls.title: Ongoing transaction monitoring
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall monitor customer transactions against their risk profile and raise documented alerts for unusual activity.

controls.title: Suspicious activity reporting
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall let compliance staff raise and file suspicious transaction reports within the regulatory deadline without notifying the customer.

controls.title: Biometric liveness and presentation-attack detection
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall perform liveness detection and face matching against the identity document for remote onboarding and reject presentation attacks.

controls.title: Document authenticity and tamper detection
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall validate uploaded identity documents for authenticity and tampering and route doubtful documents to manual review.

controls.title: Central KYC registry integration
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall look up existing records in the central KYC registry before requesting documents and upload new KYC records within the prescribed period.

controls.title: Tamper-evident audit trail of KYC decisions
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall keep a tamper-evident audit trail of every KYC decision, override and data access, recording who acted, when, and why.

controls.title: Encryption and masking of KYC data
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall encrypt KYC data in transit and at rest and mask identifiers such as Aadhaar and PAN wherever they are displayed or logged.

controls.title: Role-based access to KYC data
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall restrict access to KYC records by role on a least-privilege basis and log every access to full identity documents.

controls.title: Breach detection and notification
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall detect personal-data incidents and support notifying the regulator and affected customers within the legal deadline.

controls.title: Data-subject rights handling
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall let customers request access, correction or erasure of their data and shall record where retention law overrides erasure.

controls.title: Manual review and appeal of automated decisions
controls.suggested_requirement: The system shall route doubtful or rejected onboarding cases to a human reviewer and let customers contest an automated rejection.
